result.instructions: Tools for MyCashflow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still open, and which of them have not shipped yet?"; "Show me the stock balance of product code SKU-1042 and its last stock changes."; "Add a private note to order 1234 saying the customer asked for a split delivery.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MyCashflow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mycashflow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mycashflow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mycashflow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mycashflow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List store orders, filterable by status and by created or updated date. Use it to find orders to review or ship. Returns one page; use page and page_size to read more. API: GET /v0/orders.

tools.name: mycashflow_add_order_comment
tools.title: Add a private order comment
tools.description: Add a PRIVATE comment to an order. It is visible only to store admins and sends no email to the customer. Use it for internal notes. API: POST /v0/orders/{orderID}/comments.

tools.name: mycashflow_update_stock_balance
tools.title: Change a stock balance
tools.description: Add to or subtract from the stock balance of one product by product code. Use a negative balance_change to subtract. Each call changes the live stock count. API: POST /v1/stock/{productCode}/update-balance.

balance_change.description: The amount to add (positive) or subtract (negative).
